messages:
sara_support: Hey team — customer reports the dashboard fails to load after clicking ‘Start run’. UI shows a spinner forever and a 403 in the console. They attached one request-id in the browser header: `req-id=abcd-1234`. Can we get steps to ask them for a HAR + console logs and a minimal curl repro?

sam_support: Sorry about that — yes, ask for a HAR export + console. Short checklist to send them: 1) open DevTools (F12), 2) go to Network, check "Preserve log" and "Disable cache" (while DevTools open), 3) reproduce the issue, 4) right-click any request -> "Save all as HAR with content" and attach. Also grab a screenshot of Console errors. :thumbsup:

josh_devex: Add these extras so we can reproduce: - In Network, right-click the failing request -> Copy -> "Copy as cURL (bash)" and paste that into the ticket. That gives us exact headers/cookies. - If they can't save HAR (some browser builds), have them use chrome://net-export and upload the .log. - Ask them to try Incognito / disable extensions (adblockers can rewrite auth headers). Short message to customer:

```
Please try in Incognito and, if possible, temporarily disable extensions, then capture: DevTools -> Network (Preserve log) -> reproduce -> right-click -> Save all as HAR with content. Also: right-click failing request -> Copy -> Copy as cURL (bash) and paste here. Attach console screenshot.

If you only have one request-id, include it in the ticket (eg: req-id=abcd-1234).
```

mike_sre: If they report 403 specifically, request values we need: - full request headers (from cURL) - response body for the 403 (copy/paste or screenshot) - timestamp of reproduction (timezone helps) - which account/org they used. Also ask them to confirm whether the request shows header `x-request-id` or `req-id` and include both if present. If they're on Brave/Edge mention shields turned off.

maria_customer: Uploaded HAR to the ticket (Zendesk #4932) and pasted the cURL for the failing fetch. I ran in incognito and same 403. cURL shows cookie + Authorization header present. Screenshot attached.

sara_support: Thanks Maria — two small follow-ups: 1) Can you paste the exact cURL here (redact token if needed) — we mostly need the header names and cookie presence, 2) If you can, reproduce once with the network tab open and Export HAR with content, and then zip + upload (sometimes large). If export fails, run chrome://net-export -> Start Logging to disk -> reproduce -> Stop -> upload the .log.

josh_devex: One more tip for Windows/Mac differences: if they're on Mac and using a system proxy (or corporate network), that can mangle auth cookies. If possible, try a phone hotspot or home network to rule out corporate middleboxes. Also include the browser user agent string (right-click -> Copy -> Copy request headers).

sam_support: Final checklist for us to triage on receipt: HAR (with content) OR net-export.log, cURL for failing request, console screenshot, request-id(s), reproduction timestamp, incognito vs normal, browser + version. If we get those we can usually reproduce locally. :white_check_mark:
